c1.named_blocker: Device-critical serial-C1 Q4/Q5/Q6 projection wall. Submission is only 2.81 ms/transition and short-horizon graph capture is neutral; the retained/rejected owner ladder already closes norm, attention, Q8 activation, Q4/Q5/Q6 geometry, and payload compaction. Another target win requires a new operation-complete fusion/dataflow, not threshold or graph tuning.

complete_wall_attribution_projection.note: Projection combines the retained C2 prefill row with the clean D24 AR row; physical-grouping variance remains as documented in P2.2.

c2.named_blocker: The eager launch gap is fixed. Steady graph replay is 95.5% device-kernel time, while one graph-record model step plus the already-measured GPU-bound C2 prefill deficit account for about 250.6 of the 262.7 ms/request comparator gap. Even free graph capture projects only 18.67 tok/s. Closing C2 therefore requires the P2.2 high-row Q4/prefill algorithm or a new operation-complete row-2 fusion, not more graph-threshold tuning.
c2.rejected_reopen: Multi-step graph replay previously changed complete AR by at most +0.032%; do not reopen without a new runtime/driver premise.
